title: Mediterranean Pasta Bake
description: A hearty and flavorful pasta bake inspired by the Mediterranean. This dish is perfect for a weeknight dinner.
instructions: Cook the pasta according to package instructions until al dente. Drain and set aside.
In a large skillet, heat the tomato sauce over medium heat.
Add the garlic and cook for 1 minute until fragrant.
Stir in the artichoke hearts, olives, and feta cheese. Cook for 2-3 minutes until heated through.
Combine the cooked pasta, sauce mixture, and chopped parsley (if using) in a large bowl.
Transfer the pasta mixture to a 9x13-inch baking dish.
If using mozzarella cheese, sprinkle on top of the pasta mixture.
Bake in the preheated oven for 20-25 minutes until the cheese is melted and bubbly.
